# gls reference fixture — InternalConsistency, NOT Validated

`reference.json` is generated by `scripts/gen_gls_reference.py`, an independent
numpy computation (`np.linalg.cholesky` + `np.linalg.solve`) of the R3 GLS
whitening (Mahalanobis square) and the common-mode consistency statistic on a
fixed Ω/residual pair.

This is an **internal-consistency** check that the hand-rolled Rust Cholesky /
whitening agrees with numpy on the *same algebra* — it is **NOT** an external
accuracy oracle and does **NOT** earn a `Validated` tag. P2 makes no new accuracy
claim; the GLS whitening is Cited (Aitken 1935) and the common-mode statistic /
blind-spot bound are Proven.
